auszuege.business: Huaneng Lancang River Hydropower Inc. engages in the development, construction, operation, and management of hydropower and new energy power generation projects. It is also involved in the solar photovoltaic and wind power generation; and production and supply of electricity and heat. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Kunming, China. Huaneng Lancang River Hydropower Inc. operates as a subsidiary of China Huaneng Group Co., Ltd.
